source: Modern GPUs therefore use layers of storage. Thread-private values commonly live in registers. Threads in a block can explicitly cooperate through shared memory. Hardware-managed caches capture some reuse without explicit staging. Device memory, often ZXNAME0000XZ on datacenter AI accelerators, provides much larger capacity and very high aggregate bandwidth.[1][5][6]
zh: 因此，现代 GPU 使用存储层。线程私有值通常存在于寄存器中。块中的线程可以通过共享内存显式地进行协作。硬件管理的缓存无需显式分段即可捕获一些重用。设备内存（通常是数据中心 AI 加速器上的 ZXNAME0000XZ）提供更大的容量和非常高的聚合带宽。[1][5][6]
